bundle.shortDescription: Multi-pilot session manager for EVE Frontier
bundle.longDescription: Bifrost orchestrates isolated EVE Frontier game clients + per-pilot Brave Browser profiles + EVE Vault wallets for multi-pilot play. Uses Sandboxie (Plus or Classic) under the hood. Strictly official-APIs-only.

updater._comment_pubkey: Replace this placeholder with a real minisign public key BEFORE cutting v0.0.1. Generate with `pnpm tauri signer generate -w ~/.bifrost-updater.key`; full setup steps in docs/RELEASING.md. Builds + dev mode work with the placeholder (the JS updater store skips the check in dev), but a release built with this value will produce installs that can never auto-update.
